accepted.quote: Under the guise of parents' rights, the bill would make it more difficult for schools and districts to conduct student surveys, including mental health surveys.
accepted.bill: H.R. 4986, the Parents Opt-in Protection Act
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the bill as making school surveys more difficult, indicating opposition to the opt-in requirement.
